Bug_Title: DLS: Useless increment in return statement (DLS_DEAD_LOCAL_INCREMENT_IN_RETURN)
Bug_Details:
This statement has a return such as return x++; / return x--;.
A postfix increment/decrement does not impact the value of the expression,
so this increment/decrement has no effect.
Please verify that this statement does the right thing.
 return x++; return x--;
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by including return statements with postfix increments and decrements (return x++; and return x--;) which do not affect the returned value.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test cases call the methods showBug1 and showBug2 with an input of 5. These methods contain a return statement with a useless increment (x++) and decrement (x--) respectively. The expected output is 5, but due to the bug, the actual output remains 5, causing the test to fail as it should not have any side effects on the return value.
